One Movement. Many Voices.

Our Branch Network

15 Worship Centers across Western Kenya, all carrying the same fire.

From One Prayer Meeting to Fifteen Altars

How God multiplied what began in Mukhonje.

What started as evening prayer gatherings in Mukhonje Market became a church. That church became a movement. Today, fifteen Nehemia Worship Centers stand across the highlands of Mt. Elgon, the valleys of Trans-Nzoia, and the market towns of Bungoma and Kakamega. Each branch carries the same DNA: deep worship, sound teaching, fervent prayer, and love for community. We do not plant buildings — we plant families of faith. Every door that has opened was pushed by the hand of God and held open by covenant leadership.
